title: Streams and Screens: South Korea
summary: Magnite’s latest study explores how audiences in South Korea are engaging with ad-supported streaming and what this means for advertisers seeking more effective ways to reach viewers.
body_markdown:
##


**Live Streaming and Vertical Video Offer More Ways to Engage:** 72% of viewers live stream content at least once a month, while 95% regularly watch some form of vertical video. Both environments offer advertisers new ways to connect with a receptive audience outside of traditional ad placements. 22% regularly act on ads shown within vertical video, while 46% are more likely to remember brands that advertise during live streams compared to on demand content.


**New Ad Formats Provide Room to Innovate:** South Korean viewers are open to new ad experiences, whether that be how they are created or displayed. Consumer sentiment towards emerging formats such as Actionable, Homescreen and Pause ads is high. Similarly, 52% streamers are open to brands employing generative AI to help create and personalize ad content. Altogether, these represent considerable opportunities for brands who are willing to innovate.
